notes: v3 = two-stage generation. Learning from v2 (007): front-loading recovered the bottle/cork/gears, but the interior orrery mechanism and any fine interior detail still lose the competition for prompt attention against the exterior. v3 gives the interior its OWN full prompt budget: stage 1 (SDXL base) renders the vessel exterior with a deliberately simple interior ('glowing swirling liquid' only), then CLIPSeg masks the glass interior region and juggernautXL_versionXInpaint repaints just that region at denoise 0.75 with a dedicated interior prompt. Each entry now has: positive_prompt (exterior), mask_prompt (what CLIPSeg finds), interior_prompt + interior_negative (stage 2). Both stage-1 and final images are saved (suffix _stage1) for before/after comparison. DEPENDENCY: requires the ComfyUI-CLIPSeg custom node (same one used in the Kioo staging pipeline). Uses base + Juggernaut inpaint only — refiner dropped to avoid cycling three checkpoints through 12GB VRAM.
